verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Cloud runs Vertex AI as a first-party AI platform. Its page offers "extensive developer choice" for building agentic systems and enterprise AI agents, and the free tier mentions "AI APIs." None of the cited items explicitly describes managed model inference or names any frontier or open models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed inference endpoints, named frontier models (first-party) and open models served on the platform, a documented inference API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
